integrity: Complete mathematical proof and separately reproducible exact-rational consistency checks; all new scientific claims confined to the specified model and observation window.
scientific_limitations: Ideal stationary two-time binary detector probabilities are known for a continuum of lags, not finitely many noisy observations.
Known bounded positive speed support, fixed travel length, instantaneous threshold renewal, and independent flight speeds are essential.
The iff statement concerns the short no-reset observation window; it does not classify identifiability from the full infinite-lag record.
No stable statistical estimator or uncertainty quantification for finite samples is claimed.
Priority relative to broader classical alternating-renewal inverse theory has not been independently established.
title: A sharp detector-placement threshold for stationary ballistic-reset speed-law identification
